title: Same-follicle mechanical state/susceptibility predicts later follicle function beyond baseline output
system: ex-vivo human scalp hair-follicle organ culture; donor/region/follicle identity preserved
rationale: Current human evidence supports a directional CTS-mechanics -> progenitor/function path, but HF01 still lacks linked within-follicle evidence that an early internal mechanical observation improves prediction of later output.

gates_before_primary_analysis.requirement: the exact live-imaging acquisition regime passes HF-SIM-035 equivalence/back-action controls on later follicle growth/cycle endpoints

if a diagnostic challenge is used to estimate local susceptibility, the exact challenge/washout regime passes HF-SIM-037 before its response is treated as a predictor of a baseline-like later trajectory
early mechanical readout and later functional output belong to the same follicle; donor and scalp region remain attached as hierarchical identifiers
every baseline-enrolled follicle has a declared final disposition and HF-SIM-038 attrition/selection risks are reported before complete-case prediction is interpreted
follicles are not treated as independent human replicates; donor/region/follicle hierarchy and HF-SIM-039 pseudoreplication risk are explicit

M_state: predeclared intact-follicle width/contractile trajectory feature from minimally perturbative live imaging
M_susceptibility: finite-difference response feature to a prospectively frozen small challenge only after the active-probe recovery gate passes

late_outputs: same-follicle time to or probability of catagen transition where validly scored
biological failure/death or irreversible loss of follow-up when scientifically meaningful rather than silently deleting it

model_comparison.M0: late output ~ baseline output + region + intervention + donor structure
model_comparison.M2: M1 + early M-susceptibility feature when Gate active_probe_recovery passes

validation: evaluate prediction out of sample with donor held out, not only random follicle splits
all feature normalization, tuning, threshold selection and model selection occur inside the training donors of each validation fold
no held-out donor contributes preprocessing statistics or feature-selection decisions
report donor count separately from follicle count and never present follicles as independent human replicates
freeze feature definitions before inspecting late outcomes
retain frontal/occipital region as a declared covariate/stratum rather than pooling by default
freeze technical exclusion rules before late outcomes are inspected
report missing/dropped follicle trajectories and reasons by donor, region and intervention arm
do not condition analysis inclusion on post-baseline survival/trackability without an explicit selection model
perform declared sensitivity analyses when missing-not-at-random late output cannot be excluded
primary_success_logic: M1 improves predeclared donor-held-out prediction versus M0 in the expected direction
the improvement is not confined to one donor
confidence/calibration does not worsen materially under the predeclared criterion
the result survives the declared trajectory-attrition sensitivity analysis
the result is not dependent on leakage from held-out donors during preprocessing/tuning
if M2 is tested, M-susceptibility adds information beyond M-state and baseline output
falsification: early mechanical state fails to improve donor-held-out prediction beyond baseline output
apparent association disappears after donor/region structure is respected
apparent association disappears or reverses under plausible attrition/missingness sensitivity analyses
apparent gain disappears when all preprocessing and tuning are correctly nested inside donor-held-out validation
observer back-action or diagnostic-probe persistence cannot be bounded
the early feature is predictive only in-sample or only after post-hoc feature selection
same-unit trajectories show molecular/mechanical response without later functional rescue, weakening a simple response->recovery bridge
claim_ceiling_if_passed: within-follicle temporal predictive information in the declared ex-vivo human organ system
claims_still_blocked_if_passed: early response is sufficient for recovery
